paths.description: repo-relative path globs, / as the only separator; * matches any run of characters inside one segment; ** matches zero or more whole segments and is valid only as a whole segment; every other character is literal; an entry must contain at least one character other than * and /, and must not be absolute, start with ! or :, contain a control character (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F), or contain an empty, . or .. segment
